research.restatement_note: Final eight-period cohort statistics use all revisions available at evaluation cutoff. They do not replace the frozen selection inputs.

implementation.rule: Bond sale settles before the equity order is sized; no buy-and-resell or hidden extra fee.

realized_report.return_scope: Matched wealth outcomes; no TWR is claimed without flow-boundary values for the private stake.

outside_design.scope: Authorized contingency sale funds dated cash. Any reserve-floor gap remains visible; outside contributions are not assumed.

limits: Synthetic vintage audit and conditional policy; no empirical alpha validation, real investment recommendation, scenario probabilities or legal certification.
